data.goal: Add the missing `timeout` parameter forwarding to the top-level `httpx.stream()` function so user-provided timeout values are correctly passed through to the underlying Client stream instead of being silently ignored.

edit_targets.expected_behavior_change: Accept an explicit `timeout` argument in the `stream()` signature and pass it through to the Client constructor or its `stream()` method so the default timeout is no longer forced.

implementation_steps: Step 1: In `httpx/_api.py`, add `timeout=None` (or equivalent default) to the `stream()` function signature alongside other keyword arguments like `auth`, `proxies`, `cookies`, etc.

Step 2: In the body of `httpx/_api.py::stream()`, locate the `Client()` instantiation or the `client.stream()` call and add `timeout=timeout` to the keyword arguments being forwarded so the user-provided value reaches the transport layer.
risks: If `httpx/__init__.py` re-exports `stream` with an explicit `__all__` or a type-stub re-declares the signature, those locations may need updating to match the new parameter, but the primary runtime fix is contained within `httpx/_api.py`.
